chunks: From him, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)

That the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) gave the grandmother, mother of the father, one-sixth, and her son was alive; and gave the grandmother, mother of the mother, one-sixth, and her daughter was alive.
ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a grandmother in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific conditions under which grandmothers inherit, distinguishing between the paternal grandmother (who receives one-sixth if her son, the father, is alive) and the maternal grandmother (who receives one-sixth if her daughter, the mother, is alive). It highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the 'blocking' or 'presence' of the intermediate generation, ensuring that the grandmother's share is contingent upon the survival of her direct child in the inheritance line.
